description_en: Queries vulnerability scanning tasks under the current Alibaba Cloud account by paged query
description_zh: 分页查询当前阿里云账号下的漏洞扫描任务
name: ListVulScanTasks

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The task name. Fuzzy match is supported. The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称，支持模糊查询。长度不超过128个字符
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en: The vulnerability scanning task IDs used for filtering. A maximum of 100 IDs can be specified. Duplicate IDs are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 按漏洞扫描任务ID过滤，最多包含100个，不允许重复
parameters.name: task_ids

parameters.help_en:
Filters by task type. Valid values:
Instant: an instant task created by CreateVulScanTask.
Scheduled: a scheduled task automatically created by a vulnerability scheduled scan policy on a periodic basis
parameters.help_zh:
按任务类型过滤。取值：
Instant：即时任务，由CreateVulScanTask创建。
Scheduled：定时任务，由漏洞定时扫描策略按周期自动创建
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
Filters by the matching mode of the effective scope. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: applies to all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
UserGroupNormal: applies only to users within specified user groups
parameters.help_zh:
按生效范围的匹配方式过滤。取值：
UserGroupAll：对当前阿里云账号下的全部用户生效。
UserGroupNormal：仅对指定用户组内的用户生效
parameters.name: match_mode

parameters.help_en:
Filters by task status. Valid values:
Running: the task is in progress and still within the validity period.
Expired: the task has expired and exceeded the validity period.
Canceled: the task has been canceled
parameters.help_zh:
按任务状态过滤。取值：
Running：进行中，任务仍在有效期内。
Expired：已失效，任务已超出有效期。
Canceled：已取消
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vulnerability scheduled scan policy. This parameter is used to filter tasks triggered by the specified policy. Valid values are obtained from:
[ListVulScanScheduledStrategies](~~ListVulScanScheduledStrategies~~): lists vulnerability scheduled scan policies.
[CreateVulScanScheduledStrategy](~~CreateVulScanScheduledStrategy~~): creates a vulnerability scheduled scan policy
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞定时扫描策略ID，用于筛选由该策略触发的任务。取值来源：
[ListVulScanScheduledStrategies](~~ListVulScanScheduledStrategies~~)：批量查询漏洞定时扫描策略。
[CreateVulScanScheduledStrategy](~~CreateVulScanScheduledStrategy~~)：创建漏洞定时扫描策略
parameters.name: scheduled_strategy_id

parameters.help_en:
The user group ID. This parameter is used to filter records whose effective scope includes the specified user group. Valid values are obtained from:
[ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~): lists user groups
parameters.help_zh:
用户组ID，用于筛选生效范围包含该用户组的记录。取值来源：
[ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~)：批量查询用户组
parameters.name: user_group_id
